faq.a: Yes. The map combines confirmed and approximate addresses with sources.

faq.q: Where was the Runway HQ filmed?
faq.a: In Midtown Manhattan, with exteriors at 1221 Avenue of the Americas.
Yes. The map includes key Paris Fashion Week and finale locations.

faq.q: Does the map include exact addresses?
faq.a: Yes, when they are confirmed by production sources. Otherwise they are marked as approximate.
Some scenes were shot on sets or montages, so only a representative area can be mapped.

faq.q: Can I visit all the locations?
faq.a: Exterior locations are visitable. Some interiors are sets or private spaces.

faq.q: Where was the museum benefit scene filmed?
faq.a: The exterior was at the American Museum of Natural History, and the interior was shot in Foley Square.

faq.q: What does the coffee timeline mean?
faq.a: It is a narrative reading of moments where coffee sets the pace of the story.

faq.q: Will the map be updated with new sources?
faq.a: Yes. We add references and correct details when more precise sources appear.
